newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zairean rebel radio asks army troops to surrender.
newsitem.headline: Zairean rebel radio asks army troops to surrender.

text.p: Zairean rebels appealed on Tuesday to government troops in the capital Kinshasa to surrender to approaching rebel forces.

The appeal, broadcast from rebel Voice of the People radio in Lubumbashi in the name of the rebel military high command, said the rebels had set up surrender centres and would not harm soldiers willing to turn themselves in.

"We appeal to all government soldiers in Kinshasa to leave and present themselves to alliance commanders and troops. A surrender is important because it will avoid bloodshed in Kinshasa," said the broadcast in French.
"Troops can present themselves to alliance commanders at Kenge or at bases inside Kinshasa," it added.

Laurent Kabila's rebels say they are closing in on the teeming capital of five million and could be there in the next day or two. Kabila has appealed to ailing President Mobutu Sese Seko to give up power and prevent a bloody battle for Kinshasa.
U.S. officials have also said it may only be one or two days before the rebels take the capital.
